inputs.text: The government in Uttar Pradesh has shown a complete failure of leadership by refusing to establish a clear process for brick kiln operators to get environmental clearances three months after the mandate. This leaves these longstanding traditional businesses mired in confusion and exposed to unfair attacks from outsiders. The operators already hold the proper approvals from the State Pollution Control Board on water and air quality, and they stand ready to meet any additional requirements if the state would simply cut through the red tape, streamline the system, and remove middlemen interference. While legal experts push strict compliance with recent court decisions, the real priority must be firm authority from the top to build a workable framework that respects our way of life. This regulatory tangle is damaging our traditional local industries that sustain families, uphold social order, and strengthen the nation.
